name: 文件管理
description: SFTP 文件管理：上传下载、重命名、权限查看
author: QxSSH

apis.name: pick
apis.description: Let the user pick a file or directory: { type?: 'file'|'dir', start?, title? } -> path | null

apis.name: open
apis.description: Navigate to a path (a file opens its directory): { path } -> { hostId, path, isDir }

apis.name: stat
apis.description: Stat a remote path: { path } -> stat result

apis.name: list
apis.description: List a remote directory: { path } -> entries

apis.name: whereami
apis.description: Current workspace and the path being browsed (no args)
